name: Ronda Afiliados
author: afiliadosronda

sections.description:
Ronda connects online stores with influencers. This plugin connects WooCommerce to the Ronda service and records the order information required to calculate affiliate commissions.

The connector is free. A brand account at Ronda is required. Ronda’s affiliate service is billed separately under the commercial agreement with the brand. Installing this plugin does not subscribe you to a paid plan or initiate a charge.

What it does

  • Links your store to Ronda through WooCommerce’s standard read-only authorization screen. No API keys to copy, code editing or webhook configuration.
  • Records a first-party affiliate reference for 24 hours after a visitor follows a Ronda link.
  • Associates that reference when checkout is submitted, in both classic checkout and Checkout Blocks. A cart or draft is not a completed checkout.
  • Adds delivery/collection confirmation and a pending-return control to attributed orders. Refunds and cancellations use WooCommerce’s existing order tools.
  • Supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Provides authenticated diagnostics so Ronda can verify setup automatically.

Catalog import, sales synchronization, commissions, offers and payments are managed in Ronda. The plugin does not modify prices, collect payments, pay influencers, add storefront branding or load remote JavaScript.

External service and data

Service: Ronda, https://afiliadosronda.com.

No outbound request or affiliate tracking starts solely by installing or activating this plugin. The store manager explicitly clicks Connect with Ronda (Conectar con Ronda), which enables local tracking and opens Ronda with the public store URL. The manager then signs in or creates a brand account and approves WooCommerce’s read-only authorization. WooCommerce sends the generated read-only credentials directly to Ronda’s callback over HTTPS.

Once authorized, Ronda periodically reads catalog products and variants, identifiers, product images and URLs, prices, availability, currency, order/line identifiers, discounted amounts, taxes, checkout/payment/delivery dates, payment status, cancellations, refunds and affiliate references. Ronda requests only these order fields; it does not request buyer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses or payment card details through this connector. WooCommerce’s native API key grants read-only access; its scope is not a per-field permission.

The plugin’s protected diagnostics endpoint returns its version, public store URL and setup status to an authenticated WooCommerce manager or read-only API key. Its public compatibility endpoint exposes only version, protocol and attribution-window metadata.

Privacy policy
Data processing agreement
Service and brand registration

Cookies and consent

The plugin uses the first-party cookies ronda_affiliate (HttpOnly) and ronda_affiliate_client (cached pages). They contain an opaque affiliate reference and timestamps, expire after 24 hours, and use Secure and SameSite=Lax. A direct visit does not extend the window. Ronda independently verifies the reference signature, store and checkout time; browser data alone is not proof of a commission.

When WP Consent API is present, the plugin respects its marketing category. When it is absent, the store must configure its consent policy as appropriate before enabling tracking. The plugin does not supply a consent banner or guarantee legal compliance. Suggested policy text is added to WordPress’s Privacy Policy Guide.

Local attribution references are included in WooCommerce’s personal-data export and removed when WooCommerce erases an order’s personal data. Contact Ronda to coordinate a request concerning records already held by the service. Ronda’s retention policy is described at the privacy-policy link above.

Disabling and uninstalling

Disable tracking in WooCommerce → Ronda to stop recording new references on checkout. Deactivation also stops the plugin’s hooks. Cached storefront HTML may continue to include its local script until the cache is cleared, but checkout will not associate new references while the connector is disabled. Existing browser cookies expire within 24 hours.

To revoke Ronda’s read access as well, revoke its key in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API. Uninstall removes the connector setting only when the last installed Ronda Afiliados copy is removed, and retains order metadata needed for reconciliation. When replacing a privately installed copy with the directory version, first update the existing private copy to 1.1.2 as well; updating only the directory copy does not update the private copy. Then remove the private copy. This does not erase records already held by Ronda. Existing order metadata can be processed by WooCommerce’s privacy tools before uninstalling.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Ronda Afiliados with WooCommerce active. The public store must use HTTPS.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Ronda and select Conectar con Ronda.
  3. Sign in to your Ronda brand account (or create one). Confirm the store and approve WooCommerce’s read-only access.
  4. Ronda imports your catalog and verifies the connector automatically. Publish your offers in Ronda when it is ready.

If your store is already authorized in Ronda, use Conectar con Ronda in WordPress to verify the plugin without generating another API key.
sections.faq:
Do I need to edit code or create API keys manually?

No. Use the plugin’s Connect button and WooCommerce’s authorization screen.

Does installing the plugin start tracking immediately?

No. A WooCommerce manager must explicitly enable it using Connect with Ronda. Ronda can only read the store after the manager authorizes a read-only API key.

Does Ronda charge through WooCommerce?

No. The connector is free. Ronda’s affiliate service is billed separately according to the agreement with the brand. Commissions and payments are managed in Ronda.

Is a completed checkout already a payable commission?

No. Ronda checks payment, cancellation, delivery and returns. A paid, delivered sale completes its 30-day return period before the commission can be released. Subsequent billing and payout terms are handled in Ronda.

Is an order marked Completed automatically considered delivered?

No. Confirm actual delivery or collection in the order’s Ronda box. WooCommerce’s Completed status alone does not establish that the customer received it.

How do I confirm delivery?

Open a paid order and select Confirmar entrega o retiro in the Ronda box once the customer has received all items. This saves the confirmation immediately with the current date and records who confirmed it. Ronda reads that date on its next synchronization and starts the 30-day return period. Saving the order again does not change the confirmation date. For a return under review, check Devolución en revisión and save the order.

What if the plugin cannot be verified?

Check that it is active, tracking is enabled in WooCommerce → Ronda, HTTPS works, and security plugins allow the authorized WooCommerce REST API requests. Ronda does not enable new offers based on the public plugin probe alone.

Where do I get support?

Contact contacto@afiliadosronda.com. Do not post API keys or customer data in public support requests.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Preserve the shared tracking setting while another installed copy of Ronda Afiliados remains during a migration to the directory version.

1.1.1

  • Confirm delivery or collection with one action in the order, with a clear explanation of the confirmation date and 30-day return period.
  • Avoid recording a return-review completion note when no return was open.

1.1.0

  • Added merchant-initiated connection, explicit tracking opt-in and authenticated automatic setup verification.
  • Added read-only setup diagnostics, privacy export/erasure integration and uninstall cleanup.
  • Added translated UI strings, documentation and dependency declarations for directory distribution.
  • Preserved the same attribution, checkout, delivery and return implementation for every store.

1.0.1

  • Added local JavaScript attribution support for cached storefront pages and WP Consent API integration.

1.0.0

  • Initial connector with classic/Blocks checkout attribution and delivery/return confirmation.
